preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= pi < i for i, pi in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: The parent array p has exactly n-1 elements, where p[i-1] is the parent of vertex i (1-based), and each parent is a valid vertex number less than i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: All parent values in p are valid vertex numbers between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7, representing the number of distinct possible colorings modulo 10^9 + 7.

The output is the result of computing the number of distinct possible colorings of the tree vertices, where each coloring is reachable with non-zero probability by the paint(1) function, modulo 10^9 + 7. The function compute_distinct_colorings(n, p) is defined as follows: For a given tree structure (n, p), it returns the count of distinct colorings where each vertex can be red, white, or black, and the coloring is reachable by some sequence of random choices in the paint function.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The vertices are numbered from 1 to n inclusive.
The input (n, p) defines a valid rooted tree with root 1, where each vertex i > 1 has exactly one parent pi, and there are no cycles.
